examples.english: What do you think about this type of small pencil?

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yǐnliào hěn hǎohē.
examples.english: This kind of beverage tastes good.

examples.chinese: 這種巧克力冰淇淋又便宜又好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng qiǎokèlì bīngqílín yòu piányi yòu hǎochī.
examples.english: This kind of chocolate ice cream is both cheap and delicious.

examples.chinese: 你會說幾種語言？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì shuō jǐ zhǒng yǔyán?
examples.english: How many languages can you speak?

examples.chinese: 那家有名的麵包店賣很多種麵包，都很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā yǒumíng de miànbāo diàn mài hěn duō zhǒng miànbāo, dōu hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: That famous bakery sells many kinds of bread; all are delicious.

examples.chinese: 王老闆舉辦了一個免費吃鬆餅的活動，目的是調查哪種口味的鬆餅最受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn jǔbàn le yīgè miǎnfèi chī sōngbǐng de huódòng, mùdì shì diàochá nǎ zhǒng kǒuwèi de sōngbǐng zuì shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Boss Wang held an event with free waffles; the purpose was to investigate which flavor of waffle is most popular.

examples.chinese: 路旁有很多小白花，我常常摘一些放在書桌上，看著看著心情就愉快了。進辦公室前，別忘了摘下帽子，這是一種禮貌。
examples.pinyin: Lù páng yǒu hěn duō xiǎo bái huā, wǒ chángcháng zhāi yīxiē fàng zài shūzhuō shàng, kàn zhe kàn zhe xīnqíng jiù yúkuài le. Jìn bàngōngshì qián, bié wàng le zhāi xià màozi, zhè shì yī zhǒng lǐmào.
examples.english: There are many small white flowers by the roadside; I often pick some and put them on my desk, and as I look at them, my mood becomes cheerful. Before entering the office, don't forget to take off your hat; this is a kind of courtesy.

examples.chinese: 春天來了，天氣變暖和了，院子裡開了各種顏色的花，給人帶來一種新的希望。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, tiānqì biàn nuǎnhuo le, yuànzi lǐ kāi le gè zhǒng yánsè de huā, gěi rén dàilái yī zhǒng xīn de xīwàng.
examples.english: Spring has come, the weather has become warmer, and flowers of various colors have blossomed in the yard, bringing people a new kind of hope.

examples.chinese: 他做事的態度很差，而且一不高興就罵人，誰受得了這種人啊！
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòshì de tàidù hěn chà, érqiě yí bù gāoxìng jiù mà rén, shéi shòu de liǎo zhè zhǒng rén a!
examples.english: His attitude toward work is very bad, and whenever he is unhappy he scolds people; who can tolerate this kind of person!

examples.chinese: 這個教材比較難，老師怕學生不容易吸收，因此利用各種教學工具來幫助學生學習。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàocái bǐjiào nán, lǎoshī pà xuéshēng bù róngyì xīshōu, yīncǐ lìyòng gè zhǒng jiàoxué gōngjù lái bāngzhù xuéshēng xuéxí.
examples.english: This textbook is rather difficult; the teacher was afraid students wouldn't easily absorb it, therefore used various teaching tools to help students learn.

examples.chinese: 哥哥的想法很不實際，他一直想找一份錢多、事少、離家近的工作，但這種工作很難找啊！
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xiǎngfǎ hěn bù shíjì, tā yīzhí xiǎng zhǎo yī fèn qián duō, shì shǎo, lí jiā jìn de gōngzuò, dàn zhè zhǒng gōngzuò hěn nán zhǎo a!
examples.english: My older brother's way of thinking is very impractical; he keeps wanting to find a job with lots of money, little work, and close to home, but that kind of job is hard to find!

examples.chinese: 在真實世界中沒有「龍」這種動物，那只是古人的想像。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhēnshí shìjiè zhōng méiyǒu “lóng” zhè zhǒng dòngwù, nà zhǐshì gǔrén de xiǎngxiàng.
examples.english: In the real world, there is no such animal as a "dragon"; that is only the imagination of ancient people.

examples.chinese: 為了使市區（shìqū， urban area）的交通更便利，目前黃市長正進行各種改善計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ shìqū de jiāotōng gèng biànlì, mùqián Huáng shìzhǎng zhèng jìnxíng gè zhǒng gǎishàn jìhuà.
examples.english: In order to make traffic in the urban area more convenient, right now Mayor Huang is proceeding with various improvement plans.

examples.chinese: 元宵節時公園裡點起各式各樣的燈籠，各種顏色的燈光漂亮極了。
examples.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié shí gōngyuán lǐ diǎn qǐ gè shì gè yàng de dēnglóng, gè zhǒng yánsè de dēngguāng piàoliang jí le.
examples.english: During the Lantern Festival, various lanterns are lit in the park; the lights of all colors are extremely beautiful.

examples.chinese: 他們賣很多種飲料。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen mài hěn duō zhǒng yǐnliào.
examples.english: They have various kinds of drink.

examples.chinese: 有啊！他們有很多種冰淇淋。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu a! Tāmen yǒu hěn duō zhǒng bīngqílín.
examples.english: Oh, yeah. They have lots of kinds of ice cream.

examples.chinese: 我們下個星期要學第十五課，我剛才先看了一點兒，書上有很多種動物，我覺得很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge xīngqí yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, wǒ gāngcái xiān kàn le yìdiǎnr, shū shàng yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: We are going to learn lesson fifteen next week. I previewed a bit earlier just now. There are many kinds of animals in the book; I think it is very interesting.

examples.chinese: 華人用不一樣的動物代表每一年，一共有十二種動物。
examples.pinyin: Huárén yòng bù yíyàng de dòngwù dàibiǎo měi yì nián, yígòng yǒu shí'èr zhǒng dòngwù.
examples.english: Chinese use different animals to represent each year, and there are a total of twelve kinds of animals.

items.wordHook: a 禾(grain) holds a 重(heavy) load → every single 種(kind).

examples.chinese: 你們在聊什麼？聊得好開心。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zài liáo shénme? Liáo de hǎo kāixīn.
examples.english: What are you chatting about? You're chatting so happily.

examples.chinese: 他說話很有趣，所以每個人都喜歡跟他聊天。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn yǒuqù, suǒyǐ měi ge rén dōu xǐhuan gēn tā liáotiān.
examples.english: He speaks interestingly, so everyone likes to chat with him.

examples.chinese: 我跟朋友聊天，聊得很愉快。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyou liáotiān, liáo de hěn yúkuài.
examples.english: I chatted with friends and enjoyed it very much.

examples.chinese: 這個電視節目很無聊，我們去看電影吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège diànshì jiémù hěn wúliáo, wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng ba!
examples.english: This TV program is very boring; let's go see a movie!

examples.chinese: 那個外國學生常跟台灣朋友聊天，用中文表達自己的意見。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wàiguó xuéshēng cháng gēn Táiwān péngyǒu liáotiān, yòng Zhōngwén biǎodá zìjǐ de yìjiàn.
examples.english: That foreign student often chats with Taiwanese friends, expressing his own opinions in Chinese.

examples.chinese: 那個外國學生常跟台灣朋友聊天，用中文表達自己的意見。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wàiguó xuéshēng cháng gēn Táiwān péngyǒu liáotiān, yòng Zhōngwén biǎodá zìjǐ de yìjiàn.
examples.english: That foreign student often chats with Taiwanese friends, expressing his own opinions in Chinese.

examples.chinese: 為了練習英文的聽力和會話，我每天都跟美國朋友聊天。
examples.pinyin: Wèile liànxí Yīngwén de tīnglì hé huìhuà, wǒ měi tiān dōu gēn Měiguó péngyǒu liáotiān.
examples.english: In order to practice English listening and conversation, I chat with American friends every day.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡週末跟家人聚在一起吃飯、聊天。愛心服務社把社員的愛心聚在一起，到安養院去幫助老人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zhōumò gēn jiārén jù zài yīqǐ chīfàn, liáotiān. Àixīn fúwùshè bǎ shèyuán de àixīn jù zài yīqǐ, dào ānyǎngyuàn qù bāngzhù lǎorén.
examples.english: I like to gather with my family on weekends to eat and chat. The Love Service Club gathers the members' love together and goes to the nursing home to help the elderly.

examples.chinese: 昨天小康碰到一位好久不見的老朋友，他們聊天聊到很晚才回家。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān Xiǎo Kāng pèng dào yí wèi hǎojiǔ bú jiàn de lǎo péngyǒu, tāmen liáotiān liáo dào hěn wǎn cái huí jiā.
examples.english: Yesterday, Xiao Kang bumped into an old friend he hadn't seen for a long time; they chatted until very late before going home.

examples.chinese: 小陳很孝順，每個週末都去安養院陪父親聊天、散步，一點兒都不覺得辛苦。孝順父母的方法很多，最簡單的就是不讓他們擔心、生氣。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Chén hěn xiàoshùn, měi gè zhōumò dōu qù ānyǎngyuàn péi fùqīn liáotiān, sànbù, yīdiǎnr dōu bù juéde xīnkǔ. Xiàoshùn fùmǔ de fāngfǎ hěn duō, zuì jiǎndān de jiùshì bù ràng tāmen dānxīn, shēngqì.
examples.english: Xiao Chen is very filial; every weekend he goes to the nursing home to chat and take walks with his father, and doesn't feel the least bit tired. There are many ways to be filial to parents; the simplest is to not make them worry or get angry.

examples.chinese: 夏天的夜晚，人們喜歡在屋子外面吹著風、喝著茶，聊聊有趣的事。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, rénmen xǐhuān zài wūzi wàimiàn chuī zhe fēng, hē zhe chá, liáoliao yǒuqù de shì.
examples.english: On summer nights, people like to be outside the house, feeling the breeze, drinking tea, and chatting about interesting things.

examples.chinese: 張先生的個性很活潑、說話很幽默，跟他聊天總是很愉快。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn huópō, shuōhuà hěn yōumò, gēn tā liáotiān zǒngshì hěn yúkuài.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang's personality is very lively and his speech is very humorous; chatting with him is always very pleasant.

examples.chinese: 父母要經常陪孩子聊天、玩遊戲，給零用錢不能完全滿足孩子的需要。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yào jīngcháng péi háizi liáotiān, wán yóuxì, gěi língyòngqián bù néng wánquán mǎnzú háizi de xūyào.
examples.english: Parents should often chat and play games with their children; giving pocket money cannot completely satisfy children's needs.

examples.chinese: 跟張先生聊天時，總是我問一句，他答一句，真沒意思。
examples.pinyin: Gēn Zhāng xiānsheng liáotiān shí, zǒngshì wǒ wèn yī jù, tā dá yī jù, zhēn méi yìsi.
examples.english: When chatting with Mr. Zhang, it's always I ask one sentence and he answers one sentence; it's really boring.

examples.chinese: 叔叔時常跟我聊他到世界各地旅行的故事，真是有意思。
examples.pinyin: Shūshu shícháng gēn wǒ liáo tā dào shìjiè gèdì lǚxíng de gùshì, zhēn shì yǒu yìsi.
examples.english: My uncle often chats with me about his stories of traveling around the world; it's really interesting.

examples.chinese: 我的鞋底快要掉下來了，得去店裡請人把它粘起來。他不管我忙不忙，老是黏著我聊天，讓我覺得有點煩。夏天的時候容易流汗，讓衣服變得黏黏的，真不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xiédǐ kuàiyào diào xiàlái le, děi qù diànlǐ qǐng rén bǎ tā zhān qǐlái. Tā bùguǎn wǒ máng bù máng, lǎoshì niánzhe wǒ liáotiān, ràng wǒ juéde yǒudiǎn fán. Xiàtiān de shíhou róngyì liúhàn, ràng yīfu biànde niánnián de, zhēn bù shūfu.
examples.english: My shoe sole is about to fall off; I need to go to the shop and ask someone to glue it back on. Regardless of whether I'm busy or not, he's always clinging to me to chat, which makes me feel a bit annoyed. In summer, it's easy to sweat, making clothes sticky, which is really uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 我叔叔總是說工作很累想休息，可是休了假之後又覺得無聊。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shūshu zǒngshì shuō gōngzuò hěn lèi xiǎng xiūxi, kěshì xiū le jià zhīhòu yòu juéde wúliáo.
examples.english: My uncle always says work is tiring and he wants to rest, but after taking a vacation, he feels bored again.

examples.chinese: 當你心裡覺得難受的時候，可以跟好朋友聊聊。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ xīnlǐ juéde nánshòu de shíhou, kěyǐ gēn hǎo péngyou liáoliao.
examples.english: When you feel upset inside, you can chat with a good friend.

examples.chinese: 現代人生活忙碌，就算是好友也偶然才碰面聊聊。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén shēnghuó mánglù, jiùsuàn shì hǎoyǒu yě ǒurán cái pèngmiàn liáoliao.
examples.english: Modern people are busy with life; even good friends only meet occasionally to chat.

items.wordHook: an 耳(ear) at the 卯(mortise) catches gossip and starts to 聊(chat).

examples.chinese: 考試開始以後，我們不可以跟同學說話。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì kāishǐ yǐhòu, wǒmen bù kěyǐ gēn tóngxué shuōhuà.
examples.english: After the exam starts, we cannot talk with classmates.

examples.chinese: 下班以後，她常跟朋友一起去跑步。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, tā cháng gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ qù pǎobù.
examples.english: After getting off work, she often goes running with friends.

examples.chinese: 下班以後，我常跟同事一起去吃晚飯。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, wǒ cháng gēn tóngshì yìqǐ qù chī wǎnfàn.
examples.english: After getting off work, I often go to eat dinner with colleagues.

examples.chinese: 我希望以後可以去他家玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng yǐhòu kěyǐ qù tā jiā wán.
examples.english: I hope that in the future I can go to his house to have fun.

examples.chinese: 來台灣以後，每個週末我都有很多活動，覺得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān yǐhòu, měi ge zhōumò wǒ dōu yǒu hěn duō huódòng, juéde hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: After coming to Taiwan, I have many activities every weekend and feel very happy.

examples.chinese: 來台灣以後，我認識了很多國家的新朋友。
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān yǐhòu, wǒ rènshi le hěn duō guójiā de xīn péngyǒu.
examples.english: After coming to Taiwan, I have met many new friends from many countries.

examples.chinese: 他的計畫是畢業以後到美國去工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jìhuà shì bìyè yǐhòu dào Měiguó qù gōngzuò.
examples.english: His plan is to go to the United States to work after graduation.

examples.chinese: 哥哥洗澡以後都先喝一瓶牛奶再睡覺。
examples.pinyin: Gēge xǐzǎo yǐhòu dōu xiān hē yì píng niúnǎi zài shuìjiào.
examples.english: After my older brother takes a shower, he always first drinks a bottle of milk and then goes to sleep.

examples.chinese: 念了一個小時的書以後，你最好休息十分鐘。
examples.pinyin: Niàn le yī ge xiǎoshí de shū yǐhòu, nǐ zuìhǎo xiūxi shí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: After studying for an hour, you had better rest for ten minutes.

examples.chinese: 這種藥很有用，吃了以後頭就不疼了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào hěn yǒuyòng, chī le yǐhòu tóu jiù bù téng le.
examples.english: This kind of medicine is very useful; after taking it, your head won't hurt anymore.

examples.chinese: 下課以後，我要跟同學討論去日月潭旅行的事情。
examples.pinyin: Xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒ yào gēn tóngxué tǎolùn qù Rìyuètán lǚxíng de shìqing.
examples.english: After class, I want to discuss the trip to Sun Moon Lake with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 付了房租以後，你這個月的獎學金還剩多少？弟弟把菜都吃完了，什麼都沒剩。
examples.pinyin: Fù le fángzū yǐhòu, nǐ zhège yuè de jiǎngxuéjīn hái shèng duōshǎo? Dìdi bǎ cài dōu chī wán le, shénme dōu méi shèng.
examples.english: After paying the rent, how much of this month's scholarship do you still have left? My little brother ate all the food; nothing is left.

examples.chinese: 山本良介來台灣以後，搬了兩次家。
examples.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè lái Táiwān yǐhòu, bān le liǎng cì jiā.
examples.english: After Yamamoto Ryosuke came to Taiwan, he moved house twice.

examples.chinese: 暑假出國旅遊的人很多。這次的旅遊真有意思，我以後還想多去幾個地方玩。
examples.pinyin: Shǔjià chūguó lǚyóu de rén hěn duō. Zhè cì de lǚyóu zhēn yǒu yìsi, wǒ yǐhòu hái xiǎng duō qù jǐ gè dìfang wán.
examples.english: Many people travel abroad during summer vacation. This trip is really interesting; in the future I want to go to more places to have fun.

examples.chinese: 請你想像一下，二十年以後，你的生活會怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ xiǎngxiàng yíxià, èrshí nián yǐhòu, nǐ de shēnghuó huì zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: Please imagine: twenty years from now, what will your life be like?

examples.chinese: 他的英文、日文都很好，畢業以後想當翻譯。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Yīngwén, Rìwén dōu hěn hǎo, bìyè yǐhòu xiǎng dāng fānyì.
examples.english: His English and Japanese are both very good; after graduation he wants to be a translator.

examples.chinese: 他很煩惱，不知道畢業以後要找什麼工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn fánnǎo, bù zhīdào bìyè yǐhòu yào zhǎo shénme gōngzuò.
examples.english: He is very worried, not knowing what job to look for after graduation.

examples.chinese: 隔壁的王媽媽化妝以後，變年輕了。
examples.pinyin: Gébì de Wáng māma huàzhuāng yǐhòu, biàn niánqīng le.
examples.english: After putting on makeup, Mrs. Wang next door became younger.

examples.chinese: 運動以後最好喝開水，不要喝太甜的飲料。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng yǐhòu zuì hǎo hē kāishuǐ, bùyào hē tài tián de yǐnliào.
examples.english: After exercising, it's best to drink boiled water, not drinks that are too sweet.

examples.chinese: 有了捷運以後，台北市的交通情況改善了很多。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le jiéyùn yǐhòu, Táiběi Shì de jiāotōng qíngkuàng gǎishàn le hěn duō.
examples.english: After the MRT came, Taipei City's traffic situation improved a lot.

examples.chinese: 有了捷運以後，台北市的交通情況改善了很多。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le jiéyùn yǐhòu, Táiběi Shì de jiāotōng qíngkuàng gǎishàn le hěn duō.
examples.english: After the MRT came, Taipei City's traffic situation improved a lot.

examples.chinese: 參加社團活動，是讓自己成長的好機會。孩子出國留學以後，父母發現孩子成長了不少。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā shètuán huódòng, shì ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng de hǎo jīhuì. Háizi chūguó liúxué yǐhòu, fùmǔ fāxiàn háizi chéngzhǎng le bùshǎo.
examples.english: Participating in club activities is a good opportunity for personal growth. After their child went abroad to study, the parents found that the child had grown a lot.

examples.chinese: 王教授退休以後，每個週末都去育幼院陪孩子讀書。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu tuìxiū yǐhòu, měi ge zhōumò dōu qù yùyòuyuàn péi háizi dúshū.
examples.english: After Professor Wang retired, every weekend he goes to the orphanage to accompany the children in reading.

examples.chinese: 爸爸下班以後，總是先洗個澡、喝個飲料，再吃晚飯。
examples.pinyin: Bàba xiàbān yǐhòu, zǒngshì xiān xǐ ge zǎo, hē ge yǐnliào, zài chī wǎnfàn.
examples.english: After work, Dad always first takes a shower, has a drink, and then eats dinner.

examples.chinese: 我參加了愛心服務社以後，想法比以前更成熟了。香蕉還沒成熟的時候是綠色的，等變成黃色就熟了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cānjiā le àixīn fúwùshè yǐhòu, xiǎngfǎ bǐ yǐqián gèng chéngshú le. Xiāngjiāo hái méi chéngshú de shíhou shì lǜsè de, děng biàn chéng huángsè jiù shú le.
examples.english: After I joined the volunteer service club, my thinking has become more mature than before. When bananas are not yet ripe, they are green; when they turn yellow, they are ripe.

examples.chinese: 太陽每天都是從東方出來，從西方下去的。以凡學了中文以後，他覺得東方文化和西方文化很不一樣。
examples.pinyin: 1. Tàiyáng měitiān dōu shì cóng dōngfāng chūlái, cóng xīfāng xiàqù de. 2. Yǐfán xué le Zhōngwén yǐhòu, tā juéde dōngfāng wénhuà hé xīfāng wénhuà hěn bù yíyàng.
examples.english: 1. The sun every day comes out from the east and goes down in the west. 2. After Yifan learned Chinese, he felt that Eastern culture and Western culture are very different.

examples.chinese: 太陽每天都是從東方出來，從西方下去的。以凡學了中文以後，他覺得東方文化和西方文化很不一樣。
examples.pinyin: 1. Tàiyáng měitiān dōu shì cóng dōngfāng chūlái, cóng xīfāng xiàqù de. 2. Yǐfán xué le Zhōngwén yǐhòu, tā juéde dōngfāng wénhuà hé xīfāng wénhuà hěn bù yíyàng.
examples.english: 1. The sun every day comes out from the east and goes down in the west. 2. After Yifan learned Chinese, he felt that Eastern culture and Western culture are very different.

examples.chinese: 店員把這台咖啡機的特色說明得非常清楚，聽了他的說明以後，大家都很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Diànyuán bǎ zhè tái kāfēijī de tèsè shuōmíng de fēicháng qīngchǔ, tīngle tā de shuōmíng yǐhòu, dàjiā dōu hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: The clerk explained the features of this coffee machine very clearly. After hearing his explanation, everyone was very interested.

examples.chinese: 這個城市的空氣變乾淨了，主要是因為有捷運以後，開車的人比以前少了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de kōngqì biàn gānjìng le, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi yǒu jiéyùn yǐhòu, kāichē de rén bǐ yǐqián shǎo le.
examples.english: The air in this city has become cleaner, mainly because after the MRT was built, fewer people drive than before.

examples.chinese: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 小畢本來認為自己的書法寫得很好，但是上次比賽輸了以後，他就失去自信了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Bì běnlái rènwéi zìjǐ de shūfǎ xiě de hěn hǎo, dànshì shàng cì bǐsài shū le yǐhòu, tā jiù shīqù zìxìn le.
examples.english: Xiǎo Bì originally thought his calligraphy was very good, but after losing the last competition, he lost his self-confidence.

examples.chinese: 李小姐結婚以後的生活重心就是家庭，尤其是照顧剛出生的小孩。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě jiéhūn yǐhòu de shēnghuó zhòngxīn jiùshì jiātíng, yóuqí shì zhàogù gāng chūshēng de xiǎohái.
examples.english: After Miss Li got married, the focus of her life is her family, especially taking care of her newborn child.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠自從改善了設備以後，生產速度就一天比一天快了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng zìcóng gǎishàn le shèbèi yǐhòu, shēngchǎn sùdù jiù yī tiān bǐ yī tiān kuài le.
examples.english: Ever since that factory improved its equipment, its production speed has become faster day by day.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 不少人批評那家健身中心教練的教學品質很差，以後絕對不會再去了。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo rén pīpíng nà jiā jiànshēn zhōngxīn jiàoliàn de jiàoxué pǐnzhí hěn chà, yǐhòu juéduì bú huì zài qù le.
examples.english: Many people criticize that fitness center's coaches' teaching quality as very poor; they will absolutely not go there again.

examples.chinese: 有關這場火災的詳細情況，等調查結果出來以後，市長會向民眾報告。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè chǎng huǒzāi de xiángxì qíngkuàng, děng diàochá jiéguǒ chūlái yǐhòu, shìzhǎng huì xiàng mínzhòng bàogào.
examples.english: Regarding the detailed situation of this fire, after the investigation results come out, the mayor will report to the public.

examples.chinese: 姊姊有了自己的孩子以後，才體會到當父母是很辛苦的。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie yǒu le zìjǐ de háizi yǐhòu, cái tǐhuì dào dāng fùmǔ shì hěn xīnkǔ de.
examples.english: Only after having her own child did my older sister realize that being a parent is very hard.

examples.chinese: 這種鬧鐘有點特別，響了以後得按三下才能關掉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng nàozhōng yǒudiǎn tèbié, xiǎng le yǐhòu děi àn sān xià cái néng guān diào.
examples.english: This kind of alarm clock is a bit special: after it rings, you have to press it three times before you can turn it off.

examples.chinese: 自從有了抽號機以後，人們就不需要站著排隊了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng yǒu le chōuhàojī yǐhòu, rénmen jiù bù xūyào zhànzhe páiduì le.
examples.english: Ever since there have been queue ticket dispensers, people no longer need to stand in line.

examples.chinese: 吃了健康食品以後，還是得經常運動才能擁有好身材。
examples.pinyin: Chī le jiànkāng shípǐn yǐhòu, háishì děi jīngcháng yùndòng cái néng yōngyǒu hǎo shēncái.
examples.english: After eating health food, you still need to exercise regularly to have a good figure.

examples.chinese: 註了冊以後，新生要把相關證件各影印一份，交給學校。
examples.pinyin: Zhù le cè yǐhòu, xīnshēng yào bǎ xiāngguān zhèngjiàn gè yǐngyìn yī fèn, jiāo gěi xuéxiào.
examples.english: After registering, new students must photocopy one copy of each relevant document and submit them to the school.

examples.chinese: 食品罐頭吃完以後把罐子洗乾淨，就可以回收了。
examples.pinyin: Shípǐn guàntou chī wán yǐhòu bǎ guànzi xǐ gānjìng, jiù kěyǐ huíshōu le.
examples.english: After you finish eating canned food, wash the can clean, and then it can be recycled.

examples.chinese: 他從音樂學院畢業以後就加入歌劇團，到世界各地表演。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng yīnyuè xuéyuàn bìyè yǐhòu jiù jiārù gējùtuán, dào shìjiè gèdì biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: After graduating from the music conservatory, he joined an opera troupe and performed all over the world.

examples.chinese: 自從他改變飲食習慣以後，就變得既健康又有活力。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng tā gǎibiàn yǐnshí xíguàn yǐhòu, jiù biàn de jì jiànkāng yòu yǒu huólì.
examples.english: Ever since he changed his eating habits, he has become both healthy and full of vitality.

examples.chinese: 自從住校以後，我得學習自己收拾、整理房間。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng zhùxiào yǐhòu, wǒ děi xuéxí zìjǐ shōushi, zhěnglǐ fángjiān.
examples.english: Ever since I started living at school, I have had to learn to tidy up and organize my room myself.

examples.chinese: 知道自己誤會別人以後，最好早一點兒跟對方道歉。
examples.pinyin: Zhīdào zìjǐ wùhuì biérén yǐhòu, zuì hǎo zǎo yīdiǎnr gēn duìfāng dàoqiàn.
examples.english: After you realize you have misunderstood someone, it's best to apologize to the other person a bit earlier.

examples.chinese: 考完試以後，我們去海洋公園開開心心地玩一場吧。
examples.pinyin: Kǎo wán shì yǐhòu, wǒmen qù hǎiyáng gōngyuán kāikāixīnxīn de wán yì chǎng ba.
examples.english: After the exam is over, let's go to Ocean Park and have a fun time.

examples.chinese: 有些事明明不對，卻因沒人敢說，久了以後就被社會接受了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì míngmíng bù duì, què yīn méi rén gǎn shuō, jiǔ le yǐhòu jiù bèi shèhuì jiēshòu le.
examples.english: Some things are obviously wrong, yet because no one dares to speak up, after a long time they are accepted by society.

examples.chinese: 他想等中文程度達到高級以後，就來臺灣念大學。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng děng Zhōngwén chéngdù dádào gāojí yǐhòu, jiù lái Táiwān niàn dàxué.
examples.english: He wants to wait until his Chinese proficiency reaches the advanced level, and then come to Taiwan to attend university.

examples.chinese: 自從開始掉頭髮以後，醫師就建議他每天吃半顆維他命。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng kāishǐ diào tóufa yǐhòu, yīshī jiù jiànyì tā měitiān chī bàn kē wéitāmìng.
examples.english: Ever since he started losing hair, the doctor has suggested he take half a vitamin pill every day.

examples.chinese: 週末的時候，我喜歡跟朋友去野餐或是露營。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò de shíhou, wǒ xǐhuān gēn péngyǒu qù yěcān huòshì lùyíng.
examples.english: On weekends, I like to go picnicking or camping with friends.

examples.chinese: 以前沒什麼人喜歡露營，可是最近露營變成了一種流行的活動。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián méi shénme rén xǐhuān lùyíng, kěshì zuìjìn lùyíng biànchéngle yī zhǒng liúxíng de huódòng.
examples.english: Before, not many people liked camping, but recently camping has become a popular activity.

examples.chinese: 我家的狗很乖，從不破壞家裡的東西。颱風快來了，破壞了我本來要去露營的計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de gǒu hěn guāi, cóng bù pòhuài jiālǐ de dōngxī. Táifēng kuài lái le, pòhuài le wǒ běnlái yào qù lùyíng de jìhuà.
examples.english: Our dog is very well-behaved and never destroys things in the house. The typhoon is coming soon, and it destroyed my original plan to go camping.

examples.chinese: 我最喜歡的休閒活動是爬山和露營。為了身體和心理的健康，就算再忙，假日也應該休閒一下。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān de xiūxián huódòng shì páshān hé lùyíng. Wèile shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ de jiànkāng, jiùsuàn zài máng, jiàrì yě yīnggāi xiūxián yīxià.
examples.english: My favorite leisure activities are mountain climbing and camping. For the sake of physical and mental health, even if you're busy, you should still take some leisure time on holidays.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友昨天去河邊露營， 我們試著在河裡抓魚，沒想到真的抓到了五條魚。金先生親眼見過警察在街上抓小偷，一個跑來跑去，一個追來追去，他覺得太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu zuótiān qù hébiān lùyíng, wǒmen shìzhe zài hé lǐ zhuā yú, méi xiǎngdào zhēn de zhuā dào le wǔ tiáo yú. Jīn xiānsheng qīnyǎn jiàn guò jǐngchá zài jiē shàng zhuā xiǎotōu, yī ge pǎo lái pǎo qù, yī ge zhuī lái zhuī qù, tā juéde tài cìjī le.
examples.english: My friend and I went camping by the river yesterday; we tried to catch fish in the river, and unexpectedly, we really caught five fish. Mr. Jin has seen with his own eyes the police catching a thief on the street—one running back and forth, the other chasing back and forth—he thought it was too exciting.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 明天的露營活動還欠什麼東西？我可以帶過來。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de lùyíng huódòng hái qiàn shénme dōngxi? Wǒ kěyǐ dài guòlái.
examples.english: What else do we still owe for tomorrow's camping activity? I can bring it over.

examples.chinese: 我跟朋友的愛好一樣，都喜歡露營。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyou de àihào yíyàng, dōu xǐhuan lùyíng.
examples.english: My friend and I have the same hobby—we both like camping.

examples.chinese: 他們在露營活動中現學現唱了八首歌，真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài lùyíng huódòng zhōng xiàn xué xiàn chàng le bā shǒu gē, zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: At the camping activity, they learned and sang eight songs on the spot; that's really amazing.

examples.chinese: 露營最開心的就是當營火(campfire)燃燒時，大家在營火周圍又唱又跳。
examples.pinyin: Lùyíng zuì kāixīn de jiùshì dāng yínghuǒ ránshāo shí, dàjiā zài yínghuǒ zhōuwéi yòu chàng yòu tiào.
examples.english: The happiest part of camping is when the campfire is burning, everyone sings and dances around the campfire.

examples.chinese: 露營時我沒帶枕頭，只好把背包當作枕頭，睡起來挺不舒服的。
examples.pinyin: Lùyíng shí wǒ méi dài zhěntou, zhǐhǎo bǎ bēibāo dàngzuò zhěntou, shuì qǐlái tǐng bù shūfu de.
examples.english: When camping, I didn't bring a pillow, so I had to use my backpack as a pillow; sleeping was quite uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 為了安全起見，颱風天到山區露營的行為是被嚴格禁止的。
examples.pinyin: Wèile ānquán qǐjiàn, táifēng tiān dào shānqū lùyíng de xíngwéi shì bèi yángé jìnzhǐ de.
examples.english: For the sake of safety, camping in mountainous areas on typhoon days is strictly prohibited.

examples.chinese: 我已經坐了四、五個小時了，想出去走走！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng zuò le sì, wǔ gè xiǎoshí le, xiǎng chūqù zǒuzou!
examples.english: I have already been sitting for four or five hours, I want to go out and walk around!

examples.chinese: 要是你想出國留學，一定得加強外語能力。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ xiǎng chūguó liúxué, yídìng děi jiāqiáng wàiyǔ nénglì.
examples.english: If you want to study abroad, you definitely have to strengthen your foreign language ability.

examples.chinese: 我想出國當背包客，除了能打開視野，並能訓練自己更獨立。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chūguó dāng bēibāokè, chúle néng dǎkāi shìyě, bìng néng xùnliàn zìjǐ gèng dúlì.
examples.english: I want to go abroad as a backpacker; besides being able to broaden my horizons, and also train myself to be more independent.

examples.chinese: 沒有專業能力的人，想找到好職業是很困難的。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu zhuānyè nénglì de rén, xiǎng zhǎodào hǎo zhíyè shì hěn kùnnán de.
examples.english: For people without professional skills, finding a good job is very difficult.

examples.chinese: 陳可欣是一個勇敢、樂觀的人，什麼麻煩、困難的問題都不怕。
examples.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn shì yí ge yǒnggǎn, lèguān de rén, shénme máfan, kùnnan de wèntí dōu bú pà.
examples.english: Chen Kexin is a brave and optimistic person; she is not afraid of any troublesome or difficult problems.

examples.chinese: 在追求夢想的路上，會遇到很困難的事情，只有不斷努力，才能完成夢想。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang, huì yùdào hěn kùnnan de shìqing, zhǐyǒu bùduàn nǔlì, cái néng wánchéng mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, you will encounter very difficult things; only by making continuous efforts can you fulfill your dreams.

examples.chinese: 這個地區因為到處淹水，走路、開車都很困難，連網路也不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yīnwèi dàochù yānshuǐ, zǒulù, kāichē dōu hěn kùnnán, lián wǎnglù yě bù tōng le.
examples.english: Because this area is flooded everywhere, walking and driving are very difficult, and even the internet is not working.

examples.chinese: 歐先生有閱讀的障礙，就算一篇極短的文章，讀起來也覺得很困難。
examples.pinyin: Ōu xiānsheng yǒu yuèdú de zhàng'ài, jiùsuàn yī piān jí duǎn de wénzhāng, dú qǐlái yě juéde hěn kùnnán.
examples.english: Mr. Ou has a reading obstacle; even a very short article feels difficult for him to read.

examples.chinese: 對連電腦都不知道怎麼打開的人來說，上網購物是一件非常困難的事情。
examples.pinyin: Duì lián diànnǎo dōu bù zhīdào zěnme dǎkāi de rén lái shuō, shàngwǎng gòuwù shì yī jiàn fēicháng kùnnán de shìqíng.
examples.english: For people who don't even know how to turn on a computer, shopping online is a very difficult thing.

examples.chinese: 當我遇到挫折時，他總是協助我克服困難，我們之間也建立了珍貴的友誼。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ yùdào cuòzhé shí, tā zǒngshì xiézhù wǒ kèfú kùnnán, wǒmen zhījiān yě jiànlì le zhēnguì de yǒuyì.
examples.english: When I encounter setbacks, he always helps me overcome difficulties, and we have also established a precious friendship between us.

examples.chinese: 你聽了尤老闆勇敢克服困難、堅持到底的真實故事，有什麼感想？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng le Yóu lǎobǎn yǒnggǎn kèfú kùnnan, jiānchí dàodǐ de zhēnshí gùshi, yǒu shénme gǎnxiǎng?
examples.english: After hearing Boss You's true story of bravely overcoming difficulties and persevering to the end, what are your thoughts?

examples.chinese: 當鄰居生活遇到困難時，老馬總是主動提供協助，真令人感動。
examples.pinyin: Dāng línjū shēnghuó yùdào kùnnán shí, Lǎo Mǎ zǒngshì zhǔdòng tígōng xiézhù, zhēn lìng rén gǎndòng.
examples.english: When neighbors encounter difficulties in life, Old Ma always proactively offers assistance; it truly makes one moved.

examples.chinese: 為了愛惜食物資源，同時也幫助生活困難的家庭，張老闆決定在國內開幾家食物銀行。
examples.pinyin: Wèile àixī shíwù zīyuán, tóngshí yě bāngzhù shēnghuó kùnnán de jiātíng, Zhāng lǎobǎn juédìng zài guónèi kāi jǐ jiā shíwù yínháng.
examples.english: In order to cherish food resources and at the same time help families with financial difficulties, Boss Zhang decided to open several food banks in the country.

examples.chinese: 他們從小時候就很要好，有困難時一起解決，有好東西也會分給對方。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen cóng xiǎoshíhou jiù hěn yàohǎo, yǒu kùnnán shí yīqǐ jiějué, yǒu hǎo dōngxi yě huì fēn gěi duìfāng.
examples.english: They have been close friends since childhood; when they have difficulties, they solve them together, and when they have good things, they share them with each other.

examples.chinese: 世界上再困難的問題，不管早或晚都會有聰明的人解開的。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè shàng zài kùnnán de wèntí, bùguǎn zǎo huò wǎn dōu huì yǒu cōngmíng de rén jiě kāi de.
examples.english: No matter how difficult a problem in the world is, sooner or later there will be a smart person to solve it.

examples.chinese: 對自己的事業很熱情的人，就不怕挑戰任何困難。
examples.pinyin: Duì zìjǐ de shìyè hěn rèqíng de rén, jiù bù pà tiǎozhàn rènhé kùnnán.
examples.english: People who are very passionate about their careers are not afraid to challenge any difficulties.

examples.chinese: 碰到困難無法繼續前進時，暫時後退等待機會也是一種作法。
examples.pinyin: Pèngdào kùnnán wúfǎ jìxù qiánjìn shí, zànshí hòutuì děngdài jīhuì yě shì yī zhǒng zuòfǎ.
examples.english: When you encounter difficulties and cannot continue to advance, temporarily retreating and waiting for an opportunity is also a kind of approach.

examples.chinese: 他一直熱愛翻譯工作，不論多困難都會想辦法克服。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīzhí rè'ài fānyì gōngzuò, bùlùn duō kùnnan dōu huì xiǎng bànfǎ kèfú.
examples.english: He has always been passionate about translation work; no matter how difficult it is, he will find a way to overcome it.

examples.chinese: 看見有困難的人們，有能力的話就得想辦法幫助他們，不應該不理他們。
examples.pinyin: Kànjiàn yǒu kùnnán de rénmen, yǒu nénglì de huà jiù děi xiǎng bànfǎ bāngzhù tāmen, bù yīnggāi bù lǐ tāmen.
examples.english: When you see people in difficulty, if you are able, you should think of ways to help them; you shouldn't pay no attention to them.

examples.chinese: 當你面臨困難或挑戰時，也正是表現個人智慧與能力的最佳時刻。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ miànlín kùnnán huò tiǎozhàn shí, yě zhèng shì biǎoxiàn gèrén zhìhuì yǔ nénglì de zuì jiā shíkè.
examples.english: When you face difficulties or challenges, it is also exactly the best moment to demonstrate personal wisdom and ability.

examples.chinese: 每次當我們在學習華語上遇到困難，老師總是耐心地教導大家。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì dāng wǒmen zài xuéxí Huáyǔ shàng yùdào kùnnán, lǎoshī zǒngshì nàixīn de jiàodǎo dàjiā.
examples.english: Every time we encounter difficulties in learning Chinese, the teacher always patiently teaches everyone.

examples.chinese: 如果有任何困難請別客氣，我很樂意幫你的忙。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu rènhé kùnnan qǐng bié kèqi, wǒ hěn lèyì bāng nǐ de máng.
examples.english: If you have any difficulties, please don't be polite; I am very willing to help you.

examples.chinese: 有朋友與家人的鼓勵，使他在面對任何困難時都十分自信。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu péngyǒu yǔ jiārén de gǔlì, shǐ tā zài miànduì rènhé kùnnán shí dōu shífēn zìxìn.
examples.english: With the encouragement of friends and family, he is very confident when facing any difficulty.

examples.chinese: 中國古代的人們相信，當好人碰到危險或困難時，會有神仙到人間來幫助他們。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài de rénmen xiāngxìn, dāng hǎorén pèng dào wēixiǎn huò kùnnán shí, huì yǒu shénxiān dào rénjiān lái bāngzhù tāmen.
examples.english: People in ancient China believed that when good people encountered danger or difficulties, immortals would come to the human world to help them.

examples.chinese: 處理老房屋的問題，有時比重新建築一棟房子還要困難。
examples.pinyin: Chǔlǐ lǎo fángwū de wèntí, yǒushí bǐ chóngxīn jiànzhù yī dòng fángzi hái yào kùnnán.
examples.english: Dealing with the problems of old houses is sometimes even more difficult than building a house anew.

examples.chinese: 只有勇敢面對挑戰、克服困難的人，才能深深體會到成就感帶來的快樂。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu yǒnggǎn miànduì tiǎozhàn, kèfú kùnnán de rén, cái néng shēnshēn tǐhuì dào chéngjiùgǎn dàilái de kuàilè.
examples.english: Only those who bravely face challenges and overcome difficulties can deeply experience the happiness that a sense of accomplishment brings.

examples.chinese: 樂觀的人會積極挑戰困難，就算無法成功也不會感到失望。
examples.pinyin: Lèguān de rén huì jījí tiǎozhàn kùnnán, jiùsuàn wúfǎ chénggōng yě bù huì gǎndào shīwàng.
examples.english: Optimistic people will actively challenge difficulties; even if they cannot succeed, they will not feel disappointed.

items.wordHook: Combining 困(be stuck) and 難(hard): 困難 means difficulty.

examples.chinese: 沒有人能保證上了有名的大學，未來就一定快樂、幸福。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén néng bǎozhèng shàngle yǒumíng de dàxué, wèilái jiù yīdìng kuàilè, xìngfú.
examples.english: No one can guarantee that if you get into a famous university, you will definitely be happy and blessed in the future.

examples.chinese: 你得把保證書帶來，我們才能幫你免費修理電腦。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děi bǎ bǎozhèngshū dàilái, wǒmen cái néng bāng nǐ miǎnfèi xiūlǐ diànnǎo.
examples.english: You have to bring the warranty, and only then can we help you repair the computer for free.

examples.chinese: 你說這部筆電可以用三年，你能給我什麼保證？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō zhè bù bǐdiàn kěyǐ yòng sān nián, nǐ néng gěi wǒ shénme bǎozhèng?
examples.english: You say this laptop can be used for three years—what guarantee can you give me?

examples.chinese: 只要你堅持每天學習一個小時的中文，我保證你的程度一定會越來越好的。石先生對自己的想法很堅持，從不接受別人的意見，所以很難相處。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí měitiān xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén, wǒ bǎozhèng nǐ de chéngdù yídìng huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de. Shí xiānsheng duì zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ hěn jiānchí, cóng bù jiēshòu biérén de yìjiàn, suǒyǐ hěn nán xiāngchǔ.
examples.english: As long as you insist on studying Chinese for one hour every day, I guarantee your level will definitely get better and better. Mr. Shi is very insistent on his own ideas and never accepts others' opinions, so he is hard to get along with.

examples.chinese: 那個老闆做生意不老實，一再跟客人保證商品沒問題，其實是騙人的。
examples.pinyin: Nàge lǎobǎn zuò shēngyì bù lǎoshí, yīzài gēn kèrén bǎozhèng shāngpǐn méi wèntí, qíshí shì piànrén de.
examples.english: That boss is not honest in doing business; he repeatedly assures customers that the products have no problems, but actually it's a scam.

examples.chinese: 總統到地震災區慰問災民，並保證會協助他們恢復正常的生活。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng dào dìzhèn zāiqū wèiwèn zāimín, bìng bǎozhèng huì xiézhù tāmen huīfù zhèngcháng de shēnghuó.
examples.english: The president went to the earthquake disaster area to express sympathy and solicitude for the victims, and promised to help them restore a normal life.

examples.chinese: 大多數投資專家都不敢保證在房屋市場一定能賺錢。
examples.pinyin: Dàduōshù tóuzī zhuānjiā dōu bù gǎn bǎozhèng zài fángwū shìchǎng yīdìng néng zhuànqián.
examples.english: Most investment experts do not dare to guarantee that you can definitely make money in the housing market.

examples.chinese: 自動化工廠不僅使生產速度更快，同時也能保證產品品質。
examples.pinyin: Zìdònghuà gōngchǎng bùjǐn shǐ shēngchǎn sùdù gèng kuài, tóngshí yě néng bǎozhèng chǎnpǐn pǐnzhí.
examples.english: Automated factories not only make production speed faster but also can guarantee product quality.

items.wordHook: Combining 保(safeguard) and 證(prove): 保證 means guarantee.

examples.chinese: 小歐為了省錢，整個月都吃泡麵，最後吃壞了身體，吃藥、住院花了更多錢。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Ōu wèile shěng qián, zhěngge yuè dōu chī pàomiàn, zuìhòu chī huài le shēntǐ, chī yào, zhùyuàn huā le gèng duō qián.
examples.english: In order to save money, Xiao Ou ate instant noodles for a whole month; in the end, he ruined his health, and spent even more money on medicine and hospitalization.

examples.chinese: 你回家經過賣韓國貨的超市時，可以順便幫我買兩包泡麵嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huíjiā jīngguò mài Hánguó huò de chāoshì shí, kěyǐ shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi liǎng bāo pàomiàn ma?
examples.english: When you pass by the supermarket that sells Korean merchandise on your way home, can you conveniently buy me two packs of instant noodles?

examples.chinese: 李先生從不吃泡麵、薯條、熱狗那樣的食物，因為他覺得不健康。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng cóngbù chī pàomiàn, shǔtiáo, règǒu nàyàng de shíwù, yīnwèi tā juéde bù jiànkāng.
examples.english: Mr. Li never eats foods like instant noodles, French fries, or hot dogs, because he thinks they are unhealthy.

examples.chinese: 一聽說颱風快來了，許多民眾就去超市搶購蔬菜、水果、泡麵等食物。
examples.pinyin: Yì tīngshuō táifēng kuài lái le, xǔduō mínzhòng jiù qù chāoshì qiǎnggòu shūcài, shuǐguǒ, pàomiàn děng shíwù.
examples.english: As soon as they heard that a typhoon was coming, many people rushed to the supermarket to buy vegetables, fruit, instant noodles, and other foods.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去吃超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn. Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english: The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs. The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

examples.chinese: 這個牌子的運動服在夜市賣五百元，可是在百貨公司賣兩千元，你覺得合理嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhège páizi de yùndòngfú zài yèshì mài wǔbǎi yuán, kěshì zài bǎihuò gōngsī mài liǎngqiān yuán, nǐ juéde hélǐ ma?
examples.english: This brand of sportswear sells for five hundred yuan at the night market, but sells for two thousand yuan at the department store—do you think that's reasonable?

examples.chinese: 購物時，最好要貨比三家，才能買到品質較佳、價格較合理的商品。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shí, zuìhǎo yào huò bǐ sān jiā, cái néng mǎi dào pǐnzhì jiào jiā, jiàgé jiào hélǐ de shāngpǐn.
examples.english: When shopping, it is best to compare goods at three stores; only then can you buy products with relatively better quality and relatively more reasonable prices.

examples.chinese: 這座島的風景很美，旅館價格也很合理，難怪不少遊客年年都來這裡旅行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dǎo de fēngjǐng hěn měi, lǚguǎn jiàgé yě hěn hélǐ, nánguài bùshǎo yóukè niánnián dōu lái zhèlǐ lǚxíng.
examples.english: The scenery of this island is beautiful, and the hotel prices are also reasonable; no wonder many tourists come here to travel year after year.

examples.chinese: 有一些研究科學的人，對不科學、無法合理解釋的現象都不太相信。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē yánjiū kēxué de rén, duì bù kēxué, wúfǎ hélǐ jiěshì de xiànxiàng dōu bú tài xiāngxìn.
examples.english: Some people who study science do not really believe in unscientific phenomena that cannot be reasonably explained.

examples.chinese: 那家禮品店的商品樣式不錯，並且價格合理，所以生意很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā lǐpǐn diàn de shāngpǐn yàngshì bùcuò, bìngqiě jiàgé hélǐ, suǒyǐ shēngyì hěn hǎo.
examples.english: That gift shop's product styles are quite good, and also the prices are reasonable, so business is very good.

examples.chinese: 在自由國家，只要人民覺得不合理，都能跟相關部門抗議。
examples.pinyin: Zài zìyóu guójiā, zhǐyào rénmín juéde bù hélǐ, dōu néng gēn xiāngguān bùmén kàngyì.
examples.english: In a free country, as long as people feel something is unreasonable, they can protest to the relevant departments.

items.wordHook: When facts 合(combine) smoothly with logical 理(science) principles: 合理 means reasonable.

examples.chinese: 他對自己很小氣，可是對朋友卻很大方。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zìjǐ hěn xiǎoqì, kěshì duì péngyǒu què hěn dàfāng.
examples.english: He is very stingy with himself, but he is very generous with friends.

examples.chinese: 他沖咖啡的技術很好，香味總是比別人沖的濃。
examples.pinyin: Tā chōng kāfēi de jìshù hěn hǎo, xiāngwèi zǒngshì bǐ biérén chōng de nóng.
examples.english: His coffee-brewing technique is very good; the aroma is always stronger than that of coffee brewed by others.

examples.chinese: 空氣越髒，人們的肺也就越不健康。
examples.pinyin: Kōngqì yuè zāng, rénmen de fèi yě jiù yuè bù jiànkāng.
examples.english: The dirtier the air, the less healthy people's lungs are.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠排出的黑煙不只氣味難聞，更可怕的是可能對肺部造成傷害。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng pái chū de hēiyān bùzhǐ qìwèi nánwén, gèng kěpà de shì kěnéng duì fèibù zàochéng shānghài.
examples.english: The black smoke emitted by that factory not only smells bad, but even more frighteningly, it may cause harm to the lungs.

examples.chinese: 開冷氣時如果能好好利用電扇，房間很快就涼了。
examples.pinyin: Kā lěngqì shí rúguǒ néng hǎohǎo lìyòng diànshàn, fángjiān hěn kuài jiù liáng le.
examples.english: When turning on the air conditioner, if you can make good use of an electric fan, the room will cool down quickly.

examples.chinese: 那個眼鏡的金屬材料相當特別，因此價格比一般眼鏡貴三成。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge yǎnjìng de jīnshǔ cáiliào xiāngdāng tèbié, yīncǐ jiàgé bǐ yībān yǎnjìng guì sān chéng.
examples.english: The metal material of those glasses is quite special, so the price is thirty percent more expensive than ordinary glasses.

examples.chinese: 為了更有效地利用地球資源，我寧願減少不必要的生活享受。
examples.pinyin: Wèile gèng yǒuxiào de lìyòng dìqiú zīyuán, wǒ nìngyuàn jiǎnshǎo bù bìyào de shēnghuó xiǎngshòu.
examples.english: In order to use Earth's resources more effectively, I would rather reduce unnecessary life pleasures.

examples.chinese: 開車時不闖紅燈，是為了自己和別人的生命安全。
examples.pinyin: Kāichē shí bù chuǎng hóngdēng, shì wèile zìjǐ hé biérén de shēngmìng ānquán.
examples.english: Not running red lights when driving is for the safety of your own and others' lives.

examples.chinese: 今天搭捷運參加演唱會的民眾很多，車上擠得都不能轉身。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān dā jiéyùn cānjiā yǎnchànghuì de mínzhòng hěn duō, chē shàng jǐ de dōu bù néng zhuǎnshēn.
examples.english: There were many people taking the MRT to the concert today; the train was so crowded that you couldn't even turn around.

examples.chinese: 隨著科技進步，醫學也不斷前進，當醫師的人得多充實自己。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì jìnbù, yīxué yě bùduàn qiánjìn, dāng yīshī de rén děi duō chōngshí zìjǐ.
examples.english: With technological progress, medicine also continuously advances; those who become doctors must enrich themselves a lot.

examples.chinese: 對我來說，閱讀醫學系列的小說是一個很好的休閒活動。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, yuèdú yīxué xìliè de xiǎoshuō shì yī gè hěn hǎo de xiūxián huódòng.
examples.english: For me, reading medical series novels is a very good leisure activity.

items.wordHook: a 亻(person) rests with the 主(master) → choosing to 住(reside) here.
At the 門(door) you open your 口(mouth) to politely 問(ask) directions.
To 聽(hear) a 眾(multitude): 聽眾 means listener.
Combining 超(surpass) and 商(commerce): 超商 means convenience store.
頭(head) + 髮(hair) → the hair on your head.
